objective: Preregister 19 published long-only US-listed-ETF rules (F1 managed-futures ETFs held outright; F2 Keller/Antonacci/Faber tactical-allocation rules computed over public ETF universes; F3 other alt-diversifier ETFs held outright) for a batch screening lane (built separately) to test against K1 (own date-neutral Sharpe >= 80% of S3's in both the anchor and stress windows, positive CAGR at 20bp) or K2 (a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in both windows). No backtest is run in this round.

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (median over rebalance offsets) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH windows (anchor >=1.19, stress >=0.65), 10bp per side, positive CAGR at 20bp.
keep_rule.K2: 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH windows.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: 19 candidates; report all regardless of outcome; DSR with n_trials=19 for any that pass.
keep_rule.g3_placebo: not applicable to hold-only or fixed-rule candidates with no discretionary pick or gate-timing parameter fit locally; see candidate-manifest.json.
